english: Your drone rifles through zombie loot bags and containers and picks up dropped items as it follows you, opening them with your own loot stage and Lucky Looter. Loot goes into the drone's storage.
Read to learn to craft the Drone Auto-Loot Module at a workbench.

Your drone wrenches nearby salvageable objects (cars, sinks, working machines) apart as it follows you, into its own storage. Only touches unclaimed ground, never anyone's land claim, so it will not wreck your base.
Read to learn to craft the Drone Auto-Salvage Module at a workbench.
